scope: Focused repository-local review of recording, coordination, evidence, and host-overlay contracts. Not an exhaustive review or live host API verification.
head: 74d1f0fcd3e65751ed49a024a7e04631ede7359e

findings.finding: The manual step-done contract includes anything already staged and stages the whole plan folder. The new recording contract rejects unrelated staged/unstaged changes and forbids blanket staging, while requiring one mechanical implementation shared with the CLI.
findings.impact: With an unrelated staged file or unrelated plan-folder edit, the two sections prescribe different recording behavior. Implementers cannot infer whether the public primitive must enforce the new boundary or only an extension wrapper does.
findings.proposed_resolution: Specify the reviewed edit-set input and validation for manual step-done and the library operation, explicitly supersede the blanket-staging language, and test unrelated staged files and unrelated plan-folder edits through both entry points.

findings.finding: Writer locks are keyed by plan ID and stateful operations share the per-plan lock, but the same workflow API also handles spec editing, plan creation, ADR creation, and approvals without an existing plan ID. Their writer-lock identity and interaction with plan writers are unspecified.
findings.impact: Concurrent non-plan operations can share a checkout index and HEAD; an implementation needs a defined serialization scope before it can satisfy revision-bound validation and recording.
findings.proposed_resolution: Define checkout/repository coordination for non-plan writers, lock ordering with plan and installation locks, and revalidation under that lock. Cover two non-plan writers and a non-plan writer racing a plan operation.

findings.finding: Protocol messages use closed schemas, but artifacts are described only as {path, digest, kind} while test artifacts must also carry executable, arguments, checkout, exit status, and output digest. The contract does not specify whether those fields are inline or in the referenced artifact, their field names/types, or how core-recorded execution is correlated.
findings.impact: Independently implemented producers and validators can disagree on valid test evidence, including evidence that nested assertions actually executed.
findings.proposed_resolution: Define the test-artifact variant or referenced payload schema and execution receipt binding; share fixtures across core and adapters for successful execution, skipped child assertions, malformed evidence, and changed output bytes.
